canonical_project: Yotta Dhaka Hyperscale Data Center Park, Kaliakoir
owner: Yotta Data Services; Shamsul Alamin Group
notes: Yotta announced a Tk2000 crore hyperscale park at Hi-Tech City, Kaliakoir/Gazipur with two buildings, 4,800 racks and 28.8MW IT power. Daily Star later reported construction had begun by early August 2023.
